caption: The drawing features a stylized red bird perched on a central black branch of a decorative plant. The bird has white patterns on its wing, body, and tail, and is facing left. The plant has several sweeping black branches with pointed oval leaves detailed in black and dark green. Surrounding the central bird and plant are four large, stylized flowers: one to the left, one to the right, and two more at the lower right and top center. Each flower is composed of five prominent petals in yellow and red, with internal patterns in red and white. There is also a smaller, drooping yellow-red flower hanging from the branch on the lower left side. The plant is rooted in a red and yellow decorative pot at the bottom center of the composition, with a zigzag pattern around its body and a simple rectangular base. The entire artwork is rendered on an off-white or beige background, with most elements colored in red, yellow, black, and some details picked out in white. Small handwritten and stamped text appears on the lower margin of the drawing.
title: Drawing for Plate 8: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
